2. DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3. DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS Bicalutamide tablets, USP 50 mg for oral administration are white to off-white, round, biconvex, film coated tablets, debossed ‘B 50’ on one side and plain on other side.
